test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Niraj is the father of Rinku. Jiya and Tiya are the daughters of Ruby, who is the only sister of Rinku. Vishnu is the son of Rinku and Gita. How is Niraj related to Tiya?
solution:
According to the given information:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a68ccdfe7befad788955947f79681585ad113e7c1068f39766398933afc9c9c5.png] 

1) Niraj is the father of Rinku.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca114be0bf268baaba2a3c9d2d7a0f1adae7d8bd4760f0aa866e5011b330cce2.png] 

2) Jiya and Tiya are the daughters of Ruby, who is the only sister of Rinku.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a058e536afde42efb8359b1d24d2322d7fca1f27b64fd746354a4f41c4a500b.png] 

3) Vishnu is the son of Rinku and Gita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c2a15f181ce10ab7be68c7e4197c8deb06f03546e9a3fc549a60107618ab9af.png] 

Clearly, Niraj is Maternal grandfather of Tiya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Maternal grandfather".**
